target: 763 Origines Fabularum

source: 763 Folklore Origins
target: 763 Origines Fabularum

source: Lumian “kept his promise” and sat at the table with the two Demonesses for only a few minutes before politely taking his leave, leaving the nearby men somewhat perplexed and puzzled.
target: Lumian promissum suum servavit et ad mensam cum duabus daemonissis tantum paucis minutis consedit, deinde comiter discessit, relinquens viros proximos aliquantulum perplexos et stupefactos.

source: Shouldn’t he have seized the opportunity to pursue further?
target: Num occasionem ulterius persequendi non cepisset?

source: Could this be the advanced technique of an Intisian playboy and Dandyist?
target: Num hoc ars provecta ludentis Intisiani et dandisti esse possit?

source: Walking back to his own table, Lumian saw waiters carrying a towering stack of plates, their faces a mix of confusion, shock, and fear as they walked away.
target: Ambulans ad suam mensam, Lumian vidit ministris portantibus altam seriem patinarum, quorum vultus confusione, stupore, et timore mixti erant dum abeunt.

source: All the dishes on the menu had really been devoured!
target: Omnia fercula in menu vere devorata erant!

source: The look in their eyes towards Ludwig and Lugano was as if they were staring at monsters who had crawled out of the abyss.
target: Aspectus in oculis eorum versus Ludovicum et Lugano erat quasi intuerentur monstra, quae e abyssis reperegerunt.

source: If you knew that two-thirds of those dishes and mains were consumed by Ludwig, and Lugano and I only shared the remaining third, you’d be even more scared, worried you might be eaten too.
target: Si scires duas partes trium illorum ferculorum a Ludovico devoratas esse, et Lugano et ego solum reliquam tertiam partem communicavisse, adhuc fortius terrebres, sollicitus ne etiam tu devorarer.

source: Well, that worry would be justified… Lumian muttered silently as he sat down.
target: Ita enim, illa sollicitudo esset iusta… Lumian tacite murmurebat dum sedebat.

source: Before him, Ludwig, and Lugano, there was now a slice of apple cake and a cup of richly flavored ice cream.
target: Ante eum, Ludovicum, et Lugano, iam erat frustum placentae pomorum et poculum gelati lactis opulentissime sapidi.

source: Ludwig’s face was unmasked in satisfaction, the most fulfilled he had felt in a long time.
target: Vultus Ludovici in laetitia patefactus erat, maxime impletus quam diu sensit.

source: This was not only because the Feysacian meals were generous in portion and tasty but also because it didn’t hurt Lumian to spend someone else’s money.
target: Hoc non solum quod fercula Feysaciana porcionibus largis et sapidis parata erant, sed etiam quod Lumiano non molestum erat alicuius pecuniam consumere.

source: Lumian pushed his slice of apple cake towards Ludwig and appeared to concentrate as he scooped up the milky ice cream with a spoon and placed it in his mouth.
target: Lumian suum frustum placentae pomorum versus Ludovicum impulsavit et videtur intendere, dum cochleare adhibens gelatum lacteum subleverat atque in os suum posuit.

source: As he savored the melting frost and the spreading taste of milk, he whispered to himself, “Have any of you noticed anything unusual around Two of Cups and Seven of Cups?”
target: Dum frigus liquescentem et gustum lactis diffundentem degustabat, sibi sussurravit: “Num quis vestrum aliquid insolitum circa Duo Calices et Septem Calices animadvertit?”

source: After a brief silence, a faint, ethereal voice echoed in Lumian’s ear.
target: Post brevissimum silentium, vox tenue et aetheria in aure Lumiani resonavit.

source: It was from the Knight of Swords Maric.
target: Ea venit a Milite Gladii Maric.

source: “We did notice something, from Chaban Street until you approached St. Millom Restaurant, but only a slight abnormality was detected, and we couldn’t pinpoint its origin.”
target: “Notavimus aliquid, a via Chaban usque ad te appropinquans ad Popinam Sancti Millom, sed tantum levem anomaliam detegimus, nec eius originem determinare potuimus.”

source: This matches Franca’s description and my speculation, confirming each other…
target: Hoc correspondet cum descriptione Francae et speculatione meā, invicem confirmantes…

source: The temperance faction’s demigod is unable to catch Oxyto even though they have started tracking Franca and Jenna…
target: Semideus factionis temperantiae Oxyton capere non potest, quamquam Francam et Jennam vestigiari coeperunt…

source: Can we only wait for Oxyto to make a move?
target: Possumusne tantum exspectare ut Oxyto quid agere incipiat?

source: Lumian thought for a few seconds and pulled out a pair of non‐prescription, plain gold‐rimmed glasses for disguise from his Traveler’s Bag, placing them on his nose.
target: Lumian aliquot momenta meditatus est et duo oculi, specula non praescripta et simplicia sed aureo margine ornata, ex sacculo viatoris sui extraxit, ea in naso suo collocans.

source: He immediately saw the image of the Knight of Swords dressed in a shirt and vest highlighted in the lenses, then disappearing.
target: Statim imaginem Militis Gladii, induti camisam et vestem, in speculis illustratam, deinde evanescere, vidit.

source: The voice of Maric became clearer.
target: Vox Marici clarior facta est.

source: “We occasionally find such slight abnormalities and corresponding traces too, and that is also one of the main reasons we are sure that Oxyto is still in the Raklev area.”
target: “Interdum invenimus et talia levia anomaliae et vestigia correspondenta, quod etiam una ex causis praecipuis est, qua certi sumus Oxyton adhuc in regione Raklev esse.”

source: Can Paramita alone achieve this, managing to move undetected under the nose of a demigod with strong spiritual intuition?
target: Num Paramita sola hoc efficere potest, sinit movendi sine detegentia sub naso semidei cum valida intuitu spirituali?

source: Lumian, lacking a deep understanding of Paramita, could only speculate based on his past experiences.
target: Lumian, profundae Paramitae cognitione carens, tantum ex experimentis praeteritis coniectare poterat.

source: He had entered Paramita more than once!
target: Plusquam semel in Paramita ingressus est!

source: In Cordu, whether in reality or in dreams, he had entered Paramita several times, but at that time, without high‐level forces involved, he couldn’t judge the normal state of Paramita and whether it could deceive a demigod’s senses and intuition when it unfolded;
target: In Cordu, sive in re sive in somniis, pluries in Paramita intravit, sed eo tempore, sine viribus altioribus praesentibus, non potuit aestimare statum normalem Paramitae nec utrum sensus atque intuitus semidei decipi possent cum ipsa evolvebatur;

source: In Trier, during the Tree of Shadow catastrophe, he was involuntarily drawn into Lady Moon’s Paramita, which effectively isolated the inside from the outside, preventing Trier’s demigods from detecting the growth of the Tree of Shadow and the fighting in that area.
target: In Trieri, durante catastropha Arbores Umbrae, invitus in Paramita Dominae Lunae trahendus fuit, quae efficaciter interiora ab exterioribus segregavit, impediens semideos Trieri arboris umbrae incrementum ac pugnam in illa regione detegere.

source: It was only through Franca’s use of the Judgment card and the unique properties of Madam Judgment that they managed to establish a connection with the outside world, allowing the Tarot Club’s demigods to pinpoint and descend into Paramita.
target: Sola per usum chartae Iudicii a Franca et proprietates unicas Dominae Iudicii comparaverunt connexionem cum orbe externo, quod permisit semideis Taroc Club ad exacte determinandum et descensum in Paramita.

source: At that time, the demigods of Trier were far from Rue Anarchie, unaware of anything hidden there, which could be understood and accepted…
target: Illo tempore, semidei Trieri longe ab Rue Anarchie erant, nescii quidquid ibi celatum esset, quod intellegi atque accipi posset…

source: Memories flashed through Lumian’s mind, and he always felt that Paramita could not reach the current extent.
target: Memoriae in mente Lumiani fulserunt, et semper sensit Paramitam ad huiusmodi amplitudinem non pervenire posse.

source: When Paramita closed, it was normal that the temperance faction’s demigod couldn’t sense it even if nearby, but how could it remain undetected after unfolding right under the nose of the temperance faction’s demigod?
target: Cum Paramita clauserit, naturale erat quod semideus factionis temperantiae eam, etiam prope, non deprehenderet; sed quomodo potuit manere latens postquam ipsa sub naso semidei evoluta est?

source: Is it that powerful?
target: Estne ita potens?

source: I think even Lady Moon’s Paramita couldn’t achieve that, only capable of masking activities and protecting itself through distance from being detected…
target: Puto etiam Paramita Dominae Lunae id efficere non posse; sola idonea est ad operas occultandas atque se per distantiam ab detectione protegendam…

source: Lumian turned his gaze to the window, seeing two locals among the passersby; one had a human skull painted purple hanging on his chest, and the other tied a bleached white human skull on top of his head.
target: Lumian ad fenestram respexit, duos inter transeuntes locales videns; unus calvariam humanam purpuream in pectore pendentem habebat, alterque calvariam albidam in summitate capitis sui alligavit.

source: Death worship…
target: Cultus mortis…

source: Paramita…
target: Paramita…

source: Perhaps, Shaman King Oxyto has developed a special aspect of his Paramita in the Raklev area, which allows him to unfold it in front of a demigod without being detected, at least until there’s substantial interaction…
target: Forsitan, Rex Shaman Oxyto specialem partem Paramitae suae in regione Raklev evolverit, quae ei permittit eam in conspectu semidei sine detegentia evolvere, saltem donec notabilis interactio fiat…

source: Lumian speculated, piecing together Madame Pualis’s plan to use the folklore of Cordu to enhance her own Paramita.
target: Lumian speculavit, consilium Dominae Pualis colligens, ut fabulas Cordi ad suam Paramitam augendam adhiberet.

source: Lumian took another spoonful of milky ice cream and lowered his voice again.
target: Lumian alterum cochlearium gelati lactei cepit et vocem suam iterum demisit.

source: “Tell me more about the origins and circumstances of the Skull Blessing Festival.”
target: “Dic mihi plura de originibus ac circumstantiis Festi Benedictionis Calvariae.”

source: Knight of Swords Maric replied clearly in his ear, “It dates back to the fall of Death, when the situation on the Southern Continent fundamentally changed.
target: Miles Ensis Maric clare in aure respondit: “Ad lapsum Mortis revocatur, cum res in Continente Meridionali fundanter mutatae erant.

source: “The fall of Death caused disturbances in the Underworld, leaving most spirits unable to sense or enter it, forced instead to wander its periphery, between the spirit world and the real world.
target: “Lapsus Mortis perturbationes in Orcum attulit, multos spiritus sensu aut ingresso impeditos relinquens, qui potius per eius limitem vagari coacti sunt, inter mundum spiritualem et reale.

source: “As a result, when sentient beings die, they are very likely to become undead, wraiths, or evil spirits—a grave threat to the living, leading to one disaster after another.
target: “Ergo, cum entia animata moriuntur, verisimile est ut in non mortuos, umbras, aut spiritus malignos transformentur—periculum grave viventibus praebentes, quod in catenam calamitatum ducit.

source: “The response of the Northern Continent nations has been Church-sanctioned purification combined with compulsory cremation.
target: “Responsum nationum Continenti Septentrionali fuit purgatio Ecclesia-sancta combinata cum crematione compulsoria.

source: Here, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church and the God of Combat Church have had notable success with purification, making cremation unnecessary for those who have been purified.
target: Hic, Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Ardoris et Ecclesia Dei Pugnae purificatione insignem successum adeptae sunt, ita ut crematio iis, qui purgati sunt, non necessaria sit.

source: Hearing this, Lumian truly understood and appreciated the various measures taken before and after death, including consoling the dying, purifying the dead, encouraging cremation, and rewarding the discovery of deceased vagrants.
target: Hoc audito, Lumian vere intellexit et aestimavit varias rationes ante et post mortem captas, inter quas consolatio morientium, purgatio mortuorum, cremationis hortatio, et inventio vagantium defunctorum praemia habens.

source: The origins of all these practices was the fall of Death and the subsequent anomalies in the Underworld!
target: Origines harum omnium praxium erant lapsus Mortis atque subsequentiae anomaliae in Orcu!

source: No wonder the old bones in the lower layers of the underground tombs are still bones, not ashes…
target: Non mirum est ossa vetera in inferioribus stratis sepulchrorum subterraneorum adhuc ossa esse, non cineres…

source: During the Fourth Epoch, the Underworld hadn’t yet been disturbed, and the spirits had a place to return to…
target: Durante Aetate Quarta, Orcus nondum perturbatus erat, et spiritibus locus ad rediendum exstitit…

source: Some mysticism knowledge suggests that bodies are prone to transform at the end of the Fourth Epoch during the Pale Disaster, caused by Death’s invasion of the Northern Continent.
target: Nonnulla arcana doctrinalia suggerunt corpora ad mutationem inclinari in fine Aetatis Quartae, in tempore Caliginis Palae, ex invasione Mortis in Continentem Septentrionalem causam habentia.

source: Indeed, it is the legacy of the Pale Disaster; Death perished during that disaster, leading to the anomaly in the Underworld… Lumian suddenly realized, gaining a deeper understanding of certain mysticism knowledge.
target: Revera, hoc est legatum Caliginis Palae; Mors periit eo casu, quod ad anomaliam in Orcu duxit… Lumian subito intellexit, profundius cognitionem quarundam doctrinarum mysticarum adeptus.

source: The Knight of Swords continued, “The same issues arose on the Southern Continent, but the Balam Empire, home to many Beyonders following the Death pathway, swiftly devised several solutions that quelled the undead outbreaks in certain areas without resorting to mandatory cremation, thus restoring normalcy.
target: Miles Ensis continuavit: “Eadem problemata in Continente Meridionali evenere, sed Imperium Balam, cuius domus est plurimorum Beyonders viam Mortis sequendi, celeriter plura consilia excogitavit quae insurrectiones defunctorum in quibusdam regionibus reprimebant, ita ordinem restituentes.

source: “In other regions, however, due to ongoing independence efforts from countries like Haagenti, Paz, and the Highlands, faith in Death began to wane, leading to a period of rampant undead plagues and a power vacuum. The people in these areas had no choice but to fend for themselves.”
target: “In aliis regionibus, tamen, ob conatus independentiae perpetuos ex nationibus ut Haagenti, Paz, et Montes Altos, fides in Mortem minuere coepit, ducens ad tempus pestilentiae non mortuorum expansae et vacuitatis potentiae; in his regionibus populus nullam aliud optionem habebat nisi se ipsos tueri.”

source: Lumian nodded slightly.
target: Lumian leviter annuit.

source: “Is the Skull Blessing Festival a solution for the Raklev area?”
target: “Festum Benedictionis Calvariae solutio est pro regione Raklev?”

source: “The Skull Blessing Festival is just one manifestation,” explained the Knight of Swords simply.
target: “Festum Benedictionis Calvariae tantum una manifestatio est,” explicavit Miles Ensis simpliciter.

source: “According to records left by the Highlands Kingdom, it appears that the people of Raklev, with the help of a former official from the Balam Empire, established a mini‐state for the spirits, allowing the dead to enter and rest there without emerging again.
target: “Secundum tabulas relictas a Regno Montes Altos, videtur populus Raklev, auxilio pristini officii ex Imperio Balam, parvam civitatem pro spiritibus condidisse, ut mortui intrare possent et ibi quiescerent sine iterum emergendo.

source: “However, this isn’t the Underworld; it cannot truly offer rest, nor can it completely bind the spirits. They just have to gradually fade away.
target: “Attamen, hoc non est Orcus; neque vere quietem praebet neque spiritus omnino ligare potest. Illi solum paulatim evanescere debent.

source: “The annual Skull Blessing Festival is a day for the spirits to emerge, revel, and be liberated.
target: “Festa annua Benedictionis Calvariae dies est quo spiritus emergere, delectari et liberari possint.

source: Keeping the skulls of loved ones at home helps to protect the family from any spirits that might stray from this mini‐state, preventing them from causing harm.
target: Calvarias carorum domi retinere adiuvat familiam a spiritibus, qui ab hac parva civitate egrederentur, impediens ne damnum inferant.

source: In essence, they created a rudimentary, localized version of the Underworld for spirits to return to…
target: In essentia, parvam et rudimentariam versionem Orci locali condiderunt, ad quam spiritus redire possint…

source: A place to return to… The concept of Paramita is similar, where souls return to the earth and wander the wilderness…
target: Locus ad reditionem… Conceptus Paramitae similis est, ubi animae ad terram revertere et in vasta solitudine vagari possunt…

source: Moreover, in Paramita, spirits can return home on special days to enjoy the joy of reunion, much like the Raklev area’s Skull Blessing Festival…
target: Praeterea, in Paramita, spiritus domum redire possunt in diebus specialibus ut gaudium reitionis fruantur, sicut in Festa Benedictionis Calvariae regionis Raklev…

source: The only difference is that here, the spirits have no path to rebirth; they can only slowly fade away…
target: Unica differentia est quod hic spiritibus via ad renascentiam non praebetur; solum paulatim evanescere possunt…

source: Lumian compared the local state for the deceased to Paramita and grasped something subtle.
target: Lumian statum localem pro defunctis cum Paramita comparavit et aliquid subtiliter intelligo percepit.

source: He recalled something Louis Lund once relayed from Madame Pualis: What’s been established is merely a small, caricature Paramita, a part of the complete Paramita…
target: Meminit aliquid a Ludovico Lund olim a Madame Pualis relatum: id quod constitutum est solum parva, caricaturalis Paramita, pars Paramitae completae…

source: Hmm… Lumian inhaled sharply, muttering under his breath, “Could Oxyto be planning to merge this local spirit realm into his own Paramita, to make it more complete?
target: Hmm… Lumian acerrime inspiravit, submurmurans sub ore suo: “Num Oxyto cogitaret hanc localem rem spirituum in suam Paramitam coniungere ut eam completiorem faceretur?

source: “Has he, no, she already partially succeeded, which is why you haven’t detected her?”
target: “Num illa—non, ea iam partim successerat, qua de causa eam non detegistis?”

source: Knight of Swords Maric paused for a moment before responding, “It’s a possibility.”
target: Miles Ensis Maric paulisper sesit antequam respondit, “Possibilitas est.”

source: After a brief pause, he added proactively, “We also haven’t seen that spirit realm.”
target: Post brevem pausam, addidit prompte, “Illam rem spirituum quoque non vidimus.”

source: Seen… Lumian was initially startled but then understood what the Knight of Swords meant.
target: Visum est… Lumian initio obstupuit, sed deinde intellexit quid Miles Ensis intendisset.

source: The Prisoner pathway could directly turn into wraiths, and they should have been able to see the spirit realm, but they found nothing in Raklev this time.
target: Iter Carceris directe in umbras verterī poterat, et rem spirituum videre debuerunt, sed hoc tempore in Raklev nihil invenerunt.

source: Lumian didn’t respond but considered another issue.
target: Lumian non respondit sed aliam quaestionem consideravit.

source: If Oxyto has indeed begun to merge with that mini‐spirit realm, she essentially becomes a local version of Death, and she must have sensed the Omebella bloodline in me…
target: Si Oxyto revera coepit illam parvam rem spirituum coniungere, ipsa de facto versio localis Mortis efficietur, et debet in me sanguinem Omebellae sensit…

source: What would her reaction be?
target: Quae esset eius reactio?

source: Instant anger, or seeing it as something to be exploited?
target: Irae instantanea, an id ut rem ad exploitatum visum intueri?

source: Why didn’t she act directly? Right, she also used the bird‐clawed monster baby to discover that Ludwig nearby had the aura of a corpse ‘mother,’ adding up to what clearly looked like bait, obviously a trap!
target: Cur ea directe non egit? Recte, etiam adhibuit monstrum infans ungulis avis appendicatis, ut detegeret quod Ludwig prope habebat auram mortuae ‘matris,’ idque addens quod manifeste videbatur quasi munus, manifeste insidiae!

source: That’s why she, accustomed to indulgence, held back. What she needs to do now is, seek assistance?
target: Ideo ea, indulgentiae assueta, cesserit. Quid nunc facienda sit? Auxilium quaerere.

source: With that thought, Lumian removed his glasses and abruptly stood up.
target: Hoc cogitans, Lumian specula sua auro margine ornata sustulit et subito surrexit.
